summary: A 15 m traffic island kerb at a junction; no room to park.

drivers.seclusion: Homes within 17-33 m all round, open to the junction.
drivers.access_and_room: The line runs along a raised traffic island between lanes, so no space to pull out of traffic.
drivers.traffic: Junction of through roads; constant turning traffic.
drivers.convention: No parked cars along the island; no parking lane.

flags: Traffic island, not a parking kerb
sun_shade: Open grass island, little shade; mostly full sun.
